versions.changelog:
Initial release – quality knowledge competition skill for rapid quiz generation and competition package output.

- Generates structured quality knowledge question banks, quizzes, answer sheets, and competition schemes, primarily for Quality Month, onboarding, and daily assessments.
- Directly produces universal quality knowledge questions, covering standard areas (ISO 9001/IATF 16949, QC tools, metrology, FMEA, quality awareness, etc.), with difficulty, scoring, answers, and explanations.
- Enterprise-specific content (internal standards, processes) is marked as "待企业补充" (to be supplied) and never fabricated.
- Output includes both Markdown and polished HTML formats (question banks, quizzes, answer sheets, competition plans).
- Modular, rapid-flow process: scope confirmation, automatic question generation, interactive customization only for range/difficulty/enterprise content.
- Clearly states boundaries (no fabricated proprietary data, user-confirmed scope/rules, recommended post-generation review for accuracy).
